description: Shippable Gridbook trellis dense profile on GB10 (Blackwell sm_121). Admits the five E2M1 body rungs from the pinned Gridbook 0.9.1 candidate_rungs_q256 (TCQ_E2M1_R384/512/640/768/896) plus the scalar terminals an honest mixed menu needs (NVFP4, FP8_E4M3, BF16). Unlike trellis_research_sm121 (emulation_only, no export lane) this profile declares an export lane and is therefore shippable in structure; the remaining true blocker for a trellis artifact is ProductionWeightCache's missing trellis wire mechanism (WO-B), not a missing lane bound, and WO-C will add the pack path. The trellis wire is the Gridbook trellis wire v1 (88-byte header, schedule nibbles, offset table, alphabet blob and E2M1 group-16 FP8 E4M3 scale plane).

export_lane.exporter: prismaquant.export_native_compressed + trellis wire v1 (WO-C pack pending)
export_lane.detail: The serializer surface is the Gridbook trellis wire v1 plus the stock compressed-tensors terminals. The five E2M1 candidate rungs are the producer body; BF16/FP8_E4M3/NVFP4 are the honest scalar terminals. Until WO-B lands the cache render and WO-C the pack, export fails closed at the cache (ProductionWeightCache renders no trellis wire), not at this lane — the lane already bounds the menu exactly as the two source tables declare, so no hand-maintained deny list mirrors it.

format_rules.detail: Gridbook trellis dense on sm_121: the five E2M1 body rungs from the pinned contract's candidate_rungs_q256 plus the honest scalar terminals (BF16/FP8_E4M3/NVFP4 as existing profiles spell them). A rung outside candidate_rungs_q256 (e.g., TCQ_E2M1_R1000, legal to the reader range 256..1016 but not a candidate) is not registered and is refused by name.
The pinned Gridbook runtime publishes no routed_moe trellis cell; trellis is dense-only on sm_121 (e2m1_group16_ue4m3_static is dense-only, see lane_eligibility cells for TCQ_E2M1_R256 on sm_121).

shape_rules.detail: Trellis wire packs a 256-weight superblock along the input dim; in_features must be a multiple of 256.

serving_lanes.fallback_route: gridbook trellis dense — wire v1 decode (native)
serving_lanes.detail: Dense E2M1 trellis lane on sm_121. Route status is DERIVED from the pinned Gridbook contract's device_qualified cells (backed_with_serve_flag with GRIDBOOK_TRELLIS_E2M1 flags), never typed here (principle 14). The five rungs are the contract's candidate_rungs_q256; a rung with no cell (e.g., 384/640/768/896 today — the contract only device-qualifies 512 on sm_121) resolves unattested, which is the honest signal that the runtime has not receipted that rate. Routed expert stacks have no cell at all, so they fail closed as dense-only.

route_status_source.detail: Dense-only: the pinned contract publishes no routed_moe trellis cell, so a routed unit under this profile has no lane cell and resolves unattested. The W4A4 lane quantizes activations under e2m1_group16_ue4m3_static.

serving_lanes.activation_contract: w4a4_nvfp4_group16_static (stock CT, same wire as trellis W4A4 but different codec)
serving_lanes.detail: Scalar NVFP4 terminal for honest mixed-menu comparison; not a trellis wire but shares the same W4A4 activation numerics.
